mentions.name: AirPosture
mentions.description: This iOS app uses AirPods sensors to track head tilt in real time and catch bad posture, sending customizable alerts (with adjustable sensitivity) that nudge users to correct it before strain, neck pain, and headaches develop.
mentions.problem: Bad posture goes unnoticed and leads to neck pain and headaches; the app catches it in real time to prevent strain before it starts.
